subject: general
question: Who was the founder of Banaras Gharana of Kathak?
solution:
The Correct Answer is** __Janaki Prasad.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Janaki Prasad**

 
 
• **The Banaras Gharana of Kathak developed under the leadership of Janaki Prasad.**
 
• He was originally a resident of **Bikaner**.
 
• Imparting the intricate knowledge of this ancient dance to his disciple, he founded the Banaras Gharana of Kathak.
 
• Practitioners of Kathak Banaras Gharana are unique in that they often take turns to both the right and left with equal assurance.
 
• This Banaras gharana is different from other gharanas in many ways, including **thaat (a piece of performance) and tatkar (use of steps).**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• The spiritual center of India and one of the oldest cities in the world is Banaras. **Kathak and a particular gharana Kathak was popular in Banaras.**
 
• The three main gharanas of Kathak, a traditional dance form originating in** Uttar Pradesh, are located in Lucknow, Jaipur and Banaras.**
 
• The Vedic Sanskrit word** "Katha", meaning "story", is where the word "Kathak" originates from.**
 
• The resulting text-based analysis suggests that** Kathak is an old style of traditional Indian dance.**
 
• With the entry of the British in India, Kathak started declining. Artists passed on their knowledge to the next generation within the family as there were no written texts to preserve this art style.
